description: This file contains API utility functions for user data management, including fetching user info, projects, batch projects, and session details, with some date formatting helpers.

methods.name: wrapIsoAsMongoISODate
methods.description: Wraps an ISO string into a Mongo-shell style ISODate("...") expression, used for query parameters expecting ISODate format.

methods.name: getUserBasic
methods.description: Fetches a single user document by user ID from the API endpoint.

methods.name: getUserProjects
methods.description: Fetches distinct projects for a user, with optional time range, formatting dates as Mongo-style ISODate strings.

methods.name: getUsersProjectsBatch
methods.description: Fetches projects for multiple users in a single request, expects plain ISO strings for date range.

methods.name: getUserSessionDetails
methods.description: Fetches aggregated session details for a user, such as total count and duration.
